Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: / (feedback 'incorrect'/'please respond faster' on error or timeout)

exp3.detail: Study 3: matching task presented BEFORE the dot-probe task (order inversion to rule out association being produced by task completion); dot-probe had 24 practice + 240 trials (database stores matching task only). Matching task identical to Studies 1/2. Data: 36 participants x 128 trials (rawDataMerge.tsv from OSF umv5p; E-Prime Subject numbers entered as session numbers, corrected as Subject+Session-1 per author participantSession.txt). Paper analysis N=34 (SPSS FILTER excludes Subjects 6 and 33: one prior participation, one dot-probe RT outlier; abstract N=35 appears to be a typo). Paper matching-task statistics could NOT be reproduced from any available data version (uploaded mt_data.lst is an un-corrected 17-row intermediate with Subject 1 = merged aggregate of 20 sessions; 3 subjects have empty cells - 0 correct trials - under any filtering; author mt_data.sav not uploaded) - see 3_Reports/3_Reports/Verifying_original_results_issues.md (Issue 2). Source: paper full text + OSF umv5p merge file; [P] paper, [D] data.
